_title: Ando — Your money, calculated the Canadian way
_desc: Ando tracks your TFSA, FHSA and RRSP contribution room, amortizes your mortgage with Canadian semi-annual compounding, and accrues credit line interest daily. In English and in French.
h1: How much TFSA room do you have left?
hsub: Your budgeting app knows your spending. It doesn't know your contribution room, it amortizes your mortgage the American way, and it has never heard of an FHSA. Ando is built here, for the rules that apply here — in English and in French.
hnote: iOS 17 and later. English, French, Spanish, Portuguese.
f1s: No account needed to get started
f2s: Face ID or a passcode, if you want one
f3s: Both complete, plus Spanish and Portuguese
f4s: For the rules that apply here
jp: These aren't details. The wrong compounding method skews your mortgage payment every single month, and one contribution too many costs 1% per month in penalty. The screens below come from the app.
e1h: Your contribution room, anchored to the CRA
e1p: You enter the room shown in CRA My Account once, with its reference year. Ando then projects every contribution and every withdrawal — including the rule that catches everyone: a TFSA withdrawal only restores your room on January 1 of the following year.
e2p: In Canada, mortgage interest compounds twice a year, not twelve times. Apps built in the United States apply monthly compounding and get your payment wrong. Ando uses the equivalent periodic rate, separates principal from interest, and counts the payments you have left.
e3h: Credit lines, at the daily rate
e3p: A Canadian line of credit accrues interest every day on the balance you have drawn. Ando shows the daily rate to four decimal places, estimates the real monthly cost, tracks your utilization, and handles all three minimum payment types instead of assuming one.
ah: And everything else a real finance app needs
ap: Canadian precision is the reason to choose Ando. Day to day, it still has to be complete.

ph: Your data stays where it belongs
pp: A bank statement says where you live, where you eat, who you pay and when you were sick. Ando is built so that information doesn't leave your device unless you ask it to.
p1p: Your data lives in the app, protected by the system's encryption. No sign-up is required to get started.
p2p: Syncing across your devices runs through your own private iCloud account, not through our servers.
p3h: No access to your bank accounts
p3p: The beta works without a bank connection. If one is added later, it will be optional and the app will stay complete without it.
xh: Two tiers for the beta, one of them genuinely free
xp: What costs us nothing each month is paid for once. A subscription will come later, only for what carries a recurring cost, such as the bank connection or AI. Prices in Canadian dollars.
x0quoi: All the manual tracking, with no time limit.
x1quoi: The contribution room calculator and everything that costs nothing to run.
x2quoi: For transactions that arrive on their own. Price announced at launch.
bh: The beta opens soon on TestFlight
bp: Leave your email and you'll get the invitation. Nothing else: no newsletter, no sharing with third parties.
bnote: You can opt out at any time.
hsens: ando — the relief of knowing where you stand
fg1: Ando is not affiliated with the Canada Revenue Agency or with any financial institution. The contribution room shown is a projection calculated from the amounts you enter: your official record remains CRA My Account.
fg2: Ando does not provide financial, tax or investment advice. Screenshots show demonstration data.
